{{Top|leg}}
More than a [[Standard year/Legends|decade]] before the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Metalsmith/Legends|blacksmith]] named [[Warb Null|Shas Dovos]] discovered a '''Sith armory''' replete with [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] lore within the jungles of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Null pilfered a [[Sith spellbook/Legends|Sith spellbook]] from among the treasures, one that was also the residence of a [[Spirit protector|malevolent Sith]] [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]]. Dovos was unwittingly [[Sith training|guided]] in his studies by the spirit, and from the knowledge therein, he created a suit of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magical]] [[Sith apparel|Sith armor]].
